_comment: Drafter for Dory1.0-4B, which shares last-loop KV without adaptation: trained on traces generated by its W64 target (the pinned checkpoint with kv_policy w64, R = 4), with features and last-loop argmax labels from the original per-loop-KV Dory's teacher-forced forward (R = 4; taps are physical sublayers 3, 19/35/51 in loop d and 67 on s_d). The one drafter serves both Dory targets. Pass --traces, --out.
